findings.evidence: Lines 68–72 invoke `IsInvertible.contDiffAt_christoffelSecondKindOfJet`; `Basic.lean:177–180` already states that lemma for `[CompleteSpace E]` and `j.1.IsInvertible`. Finite dimensionality enters only through `isInvertible_of_separatingLeft hnd.1` at line 70.
findings.fix: Prove pointwise, open-domain, and global variants first for complete normed spaces with `IsInvertible`, then derive the existing finite-dimensional `Nondegenerate` variants via `isInvertible_of_separatingLeft`.
findings.issue: All three `christoffelSecondKind_family` theorems specialize the natural analytic result to `[FiniteDimensional ℝ E]` and `Nondegenerate`; the proof’s actual requirement is `[CompleteSpace E]` plus `(g p x).IsInvertible`.

summary: The family regularity API is unnecessarily restricted to finite-dimensional spaces and nondegeneracy, although its proof only needs invertibility of the musical map.
